name: Metz Solar Farm
current_developer: Metz ProjectCo Pty Ltd as trustee for Metz ProjectCo Trust
notable: 147 MW solar farm near Armidale, NSW. Developed by Canadian Solar / Recurrent Energy. Located in the New England REZ.

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

eis_specs.document_title: Metz Solar Farm Environmental Impact Statement (SSD-7931) - FRV Services Australia
eis_specs.connection_substation_name: Armidale 132 kV substation area (TransGrid / Essential Energy sub-transmission)
eis_specs.notes: FRV Services Australia (development rights acquired from Risen Energy in Nov 2020). 115 MWac / 143.5 MWdc (DC:AC ~1.25). ~320,000 modules on single-axis trackers with SMA central inverters across ~248 ha near Hillgrove, ~18 km east of Armidale on the New England Tablelands. Consent 18 July 2017; commercial operation September 2022.
